clue.text: I don't know times to go round

explanation.definitionFit: To pass by something is to go past or around it rather than stopping, a phrasal-verb synonym.

clue.text: Secretary to reveal a bit of leg

explanation.definitionFit: Pother is an old word for a fuss, a disturbance or noisy commotion.

clue.text: We hear row with love being stuck in a rut?

clue.text: Listener has one song's intro on both sides of cassette

clue.text: Lucky escape for one after virus

clue.text: Celebrate with clothes removed during heavy session: one serves alcohol

clue.text: You might see irony in this bore chasing it
